text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to the Yukoma Hot Springs Resort.
We have been expecting you.
choice_data_list: You're really getting the hang of that greeting, huh.
You're really getting the hang of that greeting, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! You bet!
I'm a genius who can even handle being an inn waitress!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, let me take your luggage!
Guiding our guests for a 3-day, 2-night stay~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time for our meeting!
Along with the folks from Tracen Academy,
we also have group reservations booked for today.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"I'd say I'd take any help I could get—even a cat's paw—
...Well, as long as you're here, I suppose I'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Teio-sama is a quick learner,
and she handles everything smoothly without any wasted effort.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, leave it to me!
Guess I'll work super duper hard today too~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Here's what you need after a hot bath!
Enjoy a local Yukoma Hot Springs Cola!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Perfect timing!
Teio-dono, you are ever so thoughtful~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you want ramen, I recommend the shop down the road!
Say the password and they'll give you a free seasoned egg♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, thank you!
Finding hidden gems that aren't in any starred restaurant guides from locals is the real thrill of traveling, isn't it?♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~!
I'm here to lay out the futons~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~~ It's hung out so nicely, it's so fluffy~~♪
I could just laze around here forever~~...♪

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guests
text_block_list.text:
"—This inn is seriously so cozy~♪
—Especially that waitress with the ponytail, she's so attentive!"

Praise for Tokai Teio could be heard all around the inn.
The guests seemed to be having a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~? Well, this much
is a piece of cake for me~!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
W-We have a situation!
The karaoke contest in the banquet hall is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? The karaoke machine is broken!?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"We're fixing it as fast as we can right now...
but the crowd is already gathering."
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone can hardly wait.
Looks like everyone can hardly wait.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...If we keep them waiting like this, it'll ruin the vacation mood, won't it?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, Trainer!
Hold these maracas!

Handing the maracas over to me,
Tokai Teio confidently strode toward the banquet stage.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, everyone!
Thank you so much for coming to our inn's karaoke contest~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"What's about to start is a super-hot singing battle!
Wait, aren't your body and mind totally relaxed from the hot springs?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And・so! Before the real thing, yours truly
will blow all that sleepiness away with a dance~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Shake the maracas along with me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! Heave-ho and away we go~♪
When a horse girl's got the blues~~♪ She steps into hot spring shoes~~♪

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guests
text_block_list.text:
—Is this the song from the "Yufumi Show"?
—Oh! This is the dance version, huh.
—Bwahaha! Isn't that fun!
"Tokai Teio steps to the rhythm while singing the bath-treading song. Her nimble dance sends a wave of excitement through the banquet hall—!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Glad the equipment is fixed.
Looks like the karaoke contest is a huge hit, too.
choice_data_list: Even so, you pulled off that ad-lib really well.
Even so, you pulled off that ad-lib really well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, when we did that hot-spring-treading performance before,
I was thinking~ maybe I could give it my own unique spin♪

She doesn't just perform the tasks she's learned; her quick
wit lets her avert trouble on the fly. Her
hospitality skills are truly something to behold.
choice_data_list: You're really amazing, aren't you, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha~!!
You may shower me with even more praise~!!"
